name: I-net Internet Services
summary: Dialup + web/IT services ISP (i-net.net.au, ~1998); evolved into 'Internetwork Solutions' (Sydney web design/hosting, 2008-12); dormant after (ACN 124 685 767).

events.details: Dormant. I-net's retail-ISP homepage exists only in Jan 1999 and the domain was a design agency by Oct 2000; the 2009-2014 'Internetwork Solutions' web-hosting business (gone after Dec 2014) is non-ISP survival, so death adjusts back to by 2000 from 2012/2014. domain had become LASDESIGN web design; later a hosting company.

refs.label: 25 Jan 1999: the only archived retail ISP homepage on the domain.
